headline: A 2011 executive order from President Obama aimed at making federal agencies more efficient, effective, and accountable.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to work more efficiently and to be more accountable for how it operates. No official summary was provided, so its specific rules, programs, or requirements cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to set expectations for how agencies run their operations and answer for their results.
